title: AIR References Index
description: Index of reference documents shared across skills and agents. References are broken out from skills to keep documentation DRY — a single reference can be used by multiple skills.

propertyNames.description: Reference identifier key. Must be alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.

Reference.description: A shared reference document that can be attached to multiple skills.

title.description: Human-readable display name for the reference.

description.description: Concise description of what knowledge this reference contains.

path.description: Path to the reference document file (typically Markdown). Either a relative path within the same catalog, or a remote URI handled by an installed catalog provider (e.g. github://owner/repo[@ref]/path/within/repo).

default_in_roots.description: Names of roots this reference is associated with by default. Use the literal "*" to associate it with every resolved root. Note: references are normally pulled in transitively by the skills/hooks that depend on them; this field declares standalone per-root membership for tooling that consumes the resolved root.default_references view.
